title: App crashes on login with Google SSO
body: Since yesterday's release, tapping 'Sign in with Google' crashes the app immediately. Stack trace shows NullPointerException in AuthCallbackHandler. Happens for every user on our team. We literally cannot log in.

title: Add dark mode support
body: Would love a dark theme option. Many of us work at night and the bright white UI is hard on the eyes. Most competitor tools have this already.

title: API returns 500 when filtering orders by date range
body: GET /api/orders?from=2026-01-01&to=2026-02-01 returns 500 Internal Server Error. Without the date params it works fine. Response body: {"error": "unhandled exception"}. We use this endpoint in our nightly reconciliation job, currently we work around it by fetching everything and filtering client-side.

title: How do I rotate my API keys?
body: I can't find anything in the docs about API key rotation. Is there an endpoint for it or do I have to delete and recreate keys manually? We have a security policy requiring rotation every 90 days.

title: Payment webhooks silently dropped — customers charged but orders not created
body: We have found at least 40 cases this week where Stripe charged the customer but our webhook handler never created the order. No error logs, the events just vanish. Support tickets are piling up and we are issuing manual refunds.

title: Typo in installation guide
body: The README says 'npm install --save-dev pakage-name'. 'pakage' should be 'package'. Trivial but makes copy-paste fail.

title: Dashboard loads very slowly with 10k+ records
body: Our workspace has about 12,000 projects and the main dashboard takes 30-45 seconds to render. Chrome profiler shows most time in a giant unindexed query. Smaller workspaces are fine. Customers with big accounts are complaining weekly.

title: Support exporting reports as CSV
body: We can only export PDF today. Finance team needs CSV to feed the numbers into their spreadsheet pipeline. This blocks our monthly close process, we currently retype numbers by hand.

title: Build fails on Node 22 with ERR_REQUIRE_ESM
body: Fresh clone, npm ci && npm run build fails on Node 22.4 with ERR_REQUIRE_ESM in the config loader. Works on Node 20. CI is pinned to 20 so it slipped through. Blocks anyone on latest Node from contributing.

title: Password reset emails not arriving for outlook.com addresses
body: Multiple users with outlook.com and hotmail.com addresses report never receiving reset emails. Gmail users are fine. SPF/DKIM look configured. These users are fully locked out of their accounts.

title: Is there a rate limit on the search endpoint?
body: We are building an integration that calls /api/search fairly heavily. Before we ship it, is there a documented rate limit? I could not find one in the API reference.

title: Add keyboard shortcuts for common actions
body: Power users would benefit from shortcuts like 'c' to create a task and '/' to focus search. Nice-to-have, not blocking anything.

title: SQL injection possible in project name field
body: Entering '; DROP TABLE-- style payloads in the project rename field produces database errors that suggest the input is concatenated into a raw query. I have not exfiltrated data but this looks exploitable. Reporting privately as instructed by SECURITY.md.

title: Docs page for webhooks returns 404
body: https://docs.example.com/webhooks linked from the dashboard returns 404. The old link on Google still works, so it looks like the page moved without a redirect.

title: Session expires after 5 minutes even with 'remember me' checked
body: Users are logged out roughly every 5 minutes regardless of the remember-me checkbox. Started after the 3.2 release. Extremely annoying but you can log back in. Affects everyone in our org.
